verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a catalog of 700+ connectors and per-connector feature tables (re-sync, data blocking, row filtering, capture deletes). None of it documents the connector's maturity (for example beta or GA), its support level, or who maintains it. Feature-support matrices are an adjacent capability and do not satisfy this story.

support.subject: As a data engineer, the catalog tells me each connector's maturity, support level, and maintainer before I depend on it
